purpose: Define and rehearse the exclusive execution boundary required before Mythical admits scheduled or event-triggered company packets. The control binds leases to exact current A-042 packet identities and A-047 exception evidence, permits one active holder, uses exclusive creation, suppresses completed idempotency replays, rejects overlap, wrong-holder release, expired work, stale fencing tokens, retries, authority and payload flags, recovers an expired lease only with a monotonically increasing fence, and terminates a real local parent/child process group without invoking a company workflow, configuring a production coordinator, or granting cycle or execution authority.
